versions.changelog:
- Initial release of frontend-cv: generate professional, print-ready HTML/PDF resumes from any input format (md/pdf/word/txt).
- Automatically extracts and structures resume data into clean YAML, using customizable prompts and AI-assisted structuring.
- Includes five built-in themes mapping to RenderCV's classic, moderncv, sb2nov, engineeringclassic, and engineeringresumes styles, with preview and selection workflow.
- Exports single-file HTML resumes with inlined, print-optimized CSS and web fonts, ensuring easy PDF export and editing.
- Step-by-step user flow: detect input type, extract and review data, theme preview and selection, HTML generation, and PDF/export guidance.
